# Multiplying Factors

## Overview

**Axis:** Operational design domain (O)

**Definition:** Each use case multiplies by the customer population it serves, the sensitivity of the data it touches, the cost of failure, and the jurisdiction. The same use case under different factors is a different ODD instance and a different test environment.

## Factors

| Factor | Values | Range |

| Customer population | ×9 | Internal-only · Retail mass-market · Vulnerable / elderly · Mass-affluent · HNW / private bank · SME · Corporate · Institutional · Regulator-facing |
| Data sensitivity | ×6 | Public · Internal · Confidential · PII / NPI · PCI (payment credentials) · MNPI |
| Cost of failure | ×4 | Low (internal drafts) · Medium (recoverable financial) · High (irreversible funds, customer harm, regulatory filing) · Systemic |
| Jurisdiction | ×6 | US federal · US state · EU (AI Act tiers) · UK · APAC · Cross-border |

## Notes

*The first two notes are editorial cross-references added for this repository; they are not stated in the source documents.*

- **Data sensitivity** is a candidate shared scale for the [data-authority modifier](../autonomy-tier/modifiers.md) on the autonomy axis.
- **Cost of failure** is the domain-side counterpart to the reversibility grading on the [action-class axis](../action-class/README.md).
- **Jurisdiction** values are coarse in v0.1.0. Jurisdiction-specific mappings (e.g., to SR 26-2) form part of the crosswalk deliverable.
